================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO AFTER EFFECTS UKATAKI - KUNAS MACHAQA
Versión 9.2.9  -  Octubre 2026
================================================================================

Demon Slayer temanakaruw 33 machaqa ANIME TEMANAKA yapxatasi, temanakan mausa efectonakapax jichhax
After Effects manqhan chiqpachapuniw uñjasi, ukat Tema Ajllirix jichhax mä sapa q'uma lista desplegablewa.

JANÏR QALLTKASA
- Jichha versionama patxar instalam, sapa kuti apnaqktam ZXP instalañampi, ukatx
  After Effects mä kutikiw machaqat qalltayam.
- Ajustenakamasa, temamasa, presetanakamasa ukat imata expresionanakamasa janiw chhaqtaniti.

MACHAQA: 33 ANIME TEMANAKA
- Flex Ajustes > TEMA AJLLIRI > PANEL TEMA ukanxa jichhax sapa animetakix mä tamaw utji:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) ukat Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Sapa personajex pachpa uñnaqaniwa: kunas mausam arki, kuna ataques mä botonar clic
  lurkta ukhaxa, kunas pasa ch'iqa botonar katxarata qhiparkta ukhaxa, ukat
  niya 2.5 segundo katxarata qhiparkta ukhax kuna explosionas utji.
- Demon Slayer temanakjamaw livianowa: efectonakax mausa sarayasax jan ukax clic lurasa ukhakiw
  irnaqapxi. AMBIENTE EFECTONAKA apagam, saminakaki qhiparañapataki.

MAYJT'AYATA: TEMA AJLLIRI
- PANEL TEMA manqhankir Demon Slayer tarjetanakax janiw utjxiti, ukhamat Flex Ajustes
  juk'amp jisk'achatawa. Taqi temanak PANEL TEMA lista desplegablet ajllim; jupax
  jichhax apnaqkta uka temanx jist'arasi.
- Kurama ukat Baryon jichhax Naruto tamanwa utjapxi.

ASKICHATA
- Temanakan mausa efectonakapax (uma, nina, illapa ukat yaqhanaka) walja kutiw After Effects
  manqhan jan uñjaskänti, Modo optimizado apagatäkchïnsa. Panelan pachpa irnaqañamp phuqhantat
  pachanakapa, ukat mä phuqhantat qalltawisa, temax k'achat sarkaspas ukhamaw amuyasïna, ukatwa
  efectonakax pachpat apagasipxäna. Jichhax, tarjeta gráfica ukax uñacht'ayki ukhaxa (walja
  computadoranakanxa), uka pachanakax efectonakarux mä juk'a pachatakikiw livianoyi.

JAN MAYJT'AYATA
- Licencia, activación ukat taqi enlacenakax nayrjamaw lurasi.
- 11 Demon Slayer temanakax 9.2.8 ukjamarakiw uñjasi.
- Yaqha taqi pestañanaka ukat herramientanakax 9.2.8 ukjamaw lurasi.
================================================================================
